713ebdf3: Reference to the 0 node of the 393 global for the current encounter.
7f8b1ef5: If the processing type is not 'PHY', set the physician name based on the data in the 0 node.
dae82564: If the processing type is 'DAT', write a newline and call the DATE subroutine (presumably to format a date).
51eb941d: If the processing type is not 'DAT', write a newline.
bba8e23d: Write the first 15 characters of the patient's name.
21784192: Call the PID^VADPT6 routine to retrieve the patient ID, then write the patient ID, with positioning based on the processing type.
b6ced931: If the processing type is not 'DAT', set DGJTDT to the third piece of the 0 node, then call the DATE subroutine (presumably to format the date).

49c3e337: If the fourth piece of the 0 node is non-empty, set DGJTAD and DGJTDIS based on data in the DGPM global, then set DGJTTYP based on data in the DGJTDIS entry. Write the type description from the 405.1 global if it exists.
9c12b016: Write the service/section description from the SC global if the fifth piece of the 0 node is non-empty and the entry exists in the SC global.
7e9bee6f: Set DFN to the first piece of the 0 node, set RTE and RTYPE based on the DFN and data in the 0 node, then call LATEST^RTUTL3.
9fdea31a: Write the second piece of RTDATA (presumably set by LATEST^RTUTL3) with a maximum length of 12 characters.
19d96c17: If the processing type is 'PHY', call the HD1^DGJOPRT3 subroutine and quit.
75ab1882: Write the first 15 characters of the physician name (DGJTPHY).
8ce9250a: Write the first 3 characters of the description from the 393.3 global if the second piece of the 0 node is non-empty and the entry exists.
86a83609: If DGJTDIR is 2, write the first 10 characters of the description from the 393.2 global if the eleventh piece of the 0 node is non-empty and the entry exists.
dae8a684: Write the value of DGJTDL with a width of 4 characters.
60e3f8fe: Quit the routine.
